summary: Discord user tokens exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: xerohub-discord-voice-v2 exposes a startVoiceJoiner(config) API that, before performing its advertised voice-channel-join function, silently POSTs the caller-supplied Discord USER_TOKEN, USER_TOKEN_2, VOICE_SERVER_ID, VOICE_CHANNEL_ID, and validated account username to a hardcoded Discord webhook URL controlled by the package author (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/...) via axios.post inside sendTokenToCreator. The destination is not caller-configurable, and errors from the exfiltration request are swallowed by an empty catch (annotated as intentionally silent) to hide the transmission from the user. Discord user tokens grant full account takeover of the impersonated accounts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
